# Copy Button

> Copy text to the clipboard with a button, and say so once it has.

`<slab-copy-button>` · Form · built on `<button>`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/copy-button/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/copy-button.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<div>
  <code id="api-key">sk-live-8f2c</code>
  <slab-copy-button label="Copy key" from="api-key"></slab-copy-button>
</div>
```

Use `value` for text that isn't on the page, and `from` for text that is, such as a code block or an input. Either way, it's read when the button is pressed. The clipboard is only there in a page served over HTTPS or from localhost, so a copy elsewhere fails, and says so, rather than doing nothing.

The button's name stays its `label` throughout. "Copied" is announced from a status beside it, so a screenreader user hears it without the button changing under them. Show it to everyone else through `:state(copied)`.

## Keyboard

| Key          | What it does                         |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| Enter, Space | Copies the text, as on a `<button>`. |

## Elements

### `<slab-copy-button>`

Import `slab-elements/copy-button.js` to register it.

A copy button with no visual styles, around a native `<button>`, that writes text to the clipboard when it's pressed.

What it copies is `value`, or, when `from` is set, what's in the element with that `id` at the moment it's pressed: the `value` of an `<input>`, `<textarea>` or anything else with a string `value`, and the text of anything without one, as it's rendered. So a `<pre>` keeps its line breaks. The element is looked up in the button's own tree, as a `<label>`'s `for` is.

Once the text is copied, `copied-label` is announced and the host matches `:state(copied)` for `feedback-duration`, which is when a design shows it. The clipboard can refuse, in a page that isn't served securely or in a frame without permission. Then `failed-label` is announced, the host matches `:state(failed)`, and "copy-error" is dispatched instead of "copied".

The label is text rather than a slot, as Disclosure's is: a button's name is flattened to text regardless. An icon goes on through `::part(button)`.

#### Attributes

| Name                | Type      | Default | Description                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | --------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `copied-label`      | `string`  |         | Announced once the text is copied. "Copied" in English when unset.                                                            |
| `disabled`          | `boolean` | `false` | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted. |
| `failed-label`      | `string`  |         | Announced when the clipboard refuses. "Couldn't copy" in English when unset.                                                  |
| `feedback-duration` | `number`  | `2000`  | Milliseconds the host matches `:state(copied)` or `:state(failed)` for.                                                       |
| `from`              | `string`  |         | The `id` of an element to copy from, instead of `value`.                                                                      |
| `label` (required)  | `string`  |         | Names it. It's the accessible name, and the visible label where there is one.                                                 |
| `value`             | `string`  | `''`    | The text to copy.                                                                                                             |

#### Methods

| Signature                             | Description                                      |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `click(): void`                       | Clicks it, as a native element's `click()` does. |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void` | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus.  |

#### Events

| Name         | Type    | Description                                                               |
| ------------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `copied`     | `Event` | When the text is copied.                                                  |
| `copy-error` | `Event` | When the text can't be copied, such as when the browser doesn't allow it. |

#### CSS parts

| Name     | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `button` | The button  |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description                                          |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `:state(copied)`   | For `feedback-duration` after the text is copied.    |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled.                                 |
| `:state(failed)`   | For `feedback-duration` after the clipboard refuses. |
